prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the supplied full-body portrait of Carys Draig's Trywydd–Rhedwyr hunting dog. Completely redraw it in a MUCH stronger 2D ANIME character-art style. Preserve the same individual dog, coat colors and markings, long-legged lean deep-chested mixed-breed anatomy, scruffy little beard, folded ears, amber eyes, brown collar, standing pose, viewing angle and vertical 2:3 composition. Preserve the quiet woodland path and distant stone wall as a simplified backdrop. THIS IS A SUBSTANTIAL STYLIZATION PASS, not a subtle filter.
Verbindliche Stilvorlage: Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
Make it visibly look like a beautifully drawn hand-animated anime animal character: confident clean dark outlines around the silhouette and facial features, expressive slightly larger clearly designed anime eyes with simple highlights, graphic pointed fur clumps instead of thousands of individual hair marks. Design the shaggy fur in FEW LARGE SIMPLIFIED SHAPES. Broad flat warm-grey and cream color fills with only TWO or THREE sharply bounded cel-shaded tones per area. Strong appealing character silhouette, expressive brows and attentive loyal personality. Clearly drawn simplified nose, paws and muzzle. Reduce texture detail by at least 80 percent across the entire image. Smooth flat color fields inside the body, no crosshatching, no fine hair rendering, no mottled photographic shading, no painterly brushwork, no microtexture, no cinematic realism, no depth-of-field lens effects. Background: simple clean anime trees in broad leaf masses, a few large stone shapes, lightly indicated grass and path; restrained, uncluttered. Still a mature elegant hunting dog, no chibi proportions. Exactly four legs. No text, frame, watermark, extra objects or other characters.
